rationale: The sensor fails to report despite a new battery, reset, and proximity to the base station, while other sensors work, indicating a hardware fault rather than network or setup issues.

output.symptom_summary: Workshop sensor offline despite new battery, reset, and proximity to base station; other sensors from same box work fine.
output.suspected_root_cause: Hardware fault in the sensor (e.g., radio failure, internal component defect).
key_abnormal_indicators: Sensor remains offline after reset with new battery
Sensor held next to base station during reset still fails
Other sensors from same box are working normally
output.customer_reply: Thank you for the details. Since the sensor remains offline even with a new battery, reset, and being next to the base station while other sensors work, this points to a hardware issue with the sensor itself. We will arrange a replacement under warranty.

complaint: The workshop sensor will not report although it has good battery and was reset. I even put a brand new battery in and held it right against the base station while resetting it. The app shows it offline. The other sensors from the same box are perfect, so I don't think it is a setup problem.
usability_reason: The response is clear, polite, and actionable (offers a warranty replacement). It avoids claiming any checks or fixes were performed, since the session record shows no questions asked or actions taken. The root-cause conclusion is reasonably inferred from the customer's reported symptoms, though it is somewhat assertive given no diagnostic steps were actually performed or confirmed.
